content:
maria: Quick heads-up from kitsune-v1 quant bring-up: major drop on vertical Han/Hanja translation tests after QAT->int6. Baseline fp16 BLEU=32.1 vs kitsune-int6 BLEU=27.8 on same split. Also seeing RTL bracket mirroring in mixed-orientation samples.

jong: ugh. paste eval command + raw outputs?

maria: ran on ci-evals, snippet: 
```
python tools/eval_translate.py --model=kitsune-v1:quant=int6:config=fast-bf16 --testset=data/vertical_hanja_mixed_orient.jsonl --metrics=bleu,chrf,em,align-coverage --batch=64 --max-len=512
```
metrics: BLEU=27.8, chrF=44.6, EM=0.62, align-coverage=0.87. baseline-fp16: BLEU=32.1, chrF=48.9, EM=0.68. eval-bot: automated-diff {"bleu":"-4.3","chrf":"-4.3","em":"-0.06"} (p<0.01).

li: minimal failing sample? tokenization or LM scoring?

maria: sample pair: 
src: "帯書きの見出し：漢字（漢字表記）［注釈］"
ref: "帯書きの見出し：漢字（注釈）［参考］"
kitsune-int6: "帯書きの見出し：漢字（漢字表記）［参考］"
issue: parentheses content duplicated/shifted; punctuation mapping seems off. plus examples with Arabic+Han show trailing -style closing angle appearing on RTL side.

li: tokenizer mapping the same as fp16?
maria: token_map_v2.json used for quant build (same). suspect runtime post-detok merge to reduce tokens; could be KVCACHE prefix handling for vertical orientation merging graphemes incorrectly.

ash: i'll bisect kernels and runtime options: (A) int6 kernels + original detok; (B) int6 + runtime-detok-merge-disabled; (C) int6 + old kvcache flush timing. ETA ~2h.

jong: i've added failing test to regression harness (PR #3421) and kicked a quick subset run on bench1.

eval-bot: quick-smoke subset: kitsune-int6-subset BLEU=28.1 -> baseline-fp16-subset BLEU=32.4. same direction.

li: if detok merge is culprit, we might be treating fullwidth punctuation as detachable in vertical flows. will grep for zenkaku handlers.

maria: example mixed-orient weirdness: src: "שלום (注)漢字" -> kitsune produced closing-angle on Arabic segment. suggests bidi anchor applied after char-level detok.

ash: plan: reproduce locally, run three kernel/runtime toggles, capture sample outputs + BLEU per variant. if it's only runtime-detok, add locale-aware gate for merge and short-term revert.

maria: action items: 1) ash bisect + post commits/hashes; 2) li audit detok/tokenizer mapping for vertical orientation; 3) jong maintain harness + add human-inspection set. jong: please run chrF-focused analysis too since BLEU is length-sensitive for vertical linewrap.

jong: noted. will add small targeted check for bracket handling across LTR/RTL anchors.

maria: tagging rf: potential P0 for kitsune-int6 multilang bring-up if regression holds. keep updates here. :pray:

ash: bisect started (job kicked at 2765432130). will post intermediate hashes and ~5 failing examples for each variant.

(END)
